findings.summary: Two exported page aliases appear unused after the Reader page types were moved to generated manifest types.
findings.consequence: The module retains a small public surface that does not enforce a policy or simplify callers; future readers have to check whether these aliases carry semantics beyond the generated WorkManifestPage types.
findings.evidence: Lines 157-158 export ReaderSourcePage and ReaderFacsimileSourcePage as direct aliases. Repository search found no references to either alias outside their definitions, while direct reader callers import ReaderEtextWorkMetadata and ReaderFacsimileWorkMetadata instead.
findings.recommendation: Delete the two aliases if no external package consumes this server utility API, or move them to shared/types/reader.ts only if they are intended as stable Reader-facing names.
